scam_report.summary: High-confidence scam indicators identified. Message exhibits 3 core deceptive tactic(s) characteristic of 'Bank KYC / Account Suspension Deception'. High risk of financial loss or credential compromise.
scam_report.model_used: Deterministic Rule-Based Intelligence Engine (No LLM key configured)

tactics.name: Fake Bank KYC / Account Block Coercion
tactics.explanation: Coercive alert claiming account deactivation or pending KYC, prompting user to click unverified links or call unauthorized numbers.

tactics.name: Direct OTP Solicitation
tactics.explanation: Explicitly asks the recipient to share or enter a One Time Password (OTP). Legitimate financial institutions never solicit OTPs.

tactics.name: Artificial Urgency & Coercive Pressure
tactics.explanation: Creates psychological panic using aggressive deadlines or threatened legal action to bypass critical thinking.

extracted_indicators.context_snippet: ...KYC immediately at https://example.com/kyc and share your OTP...

recommended_actions: Do NOT click any links, open attachments, or call numbers listed in the message.
NEVER share OTPs, PINs, passwords, or install screen-sharing software (AnyDesk, TeamViewer).
If this claims to be your bank, verify only through the official banking app or branch.
Report suspected cyber fraud immediately via India's National Helpline 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in (prompt reporting is recommended to request holds, though recovery cannot be guaranteed).
limitations: Rule-based deterministic analysis: Evaluation is based on heuristic lexical and behavioral patterns.
Absence of detected scam signatures does not guarantee the message is 100% genuine.
Always verify financial requests directly with your institution before transferring funds.
scam_report.disclaimer: A Low Risk result does not guarantee that a message is authentic or safe. Absence of known scam patterns is not proof of legitimacy. Always verify directly through official channels.
